description:
Eighteen-year-old Misa finds life hard, torn apart by constant pressure. She wakes up after a car accident on a school trip, only to find herself ten years into the future?! 

"I'm twenty-eight?" Suddenly, a handsome man, Jung Yoon-Ha, appears before her. "I'm your husband." Oh my! … … Wait, isn't this a huge win? A wife with amnesia and a husband full of secrets: the perilous newlywed story!
